Latte Art Tutorial: Winged Heart

This comes down to pour mechanics — the same science I break down for heart & onion heart in my course, The Science of Silk. ☕
Check profile link for online course details🥇
— still a newbie, still obsessed ☕

Level 1
While doing the wiggle base, pushing forward only to behind the middle line, this causes the pattern to be stuck at the top, not well layered. The base would also be too thick, the ratio of the whole pattern is not ideal. This is a very common mistake for people who just start to practice wiggle.

Level 99
Push forward to pass the middle line while wiggling for the wiggle base, convection is better, lines would be clearer, and there is more room for leaf part for a more complete design.
